purpose: Attach a post-decision campaign OUTCOME to an immutable router freeze WITHOUT modifying the freeze. Outcomes live in a separate append-only ledger.
immutability_rules: never append outcome values inside the freeze record
never regenerate the freeze using outcome information
never rewrite a genuine prospective ledger line
never promote a synthetic/backfill record into prospective evidence
idempotency_rules: repeating the same outcome event must not produce another outcome record
conflicting outcome evidence appends a CONTRADICTION/revision event, never overwrites

instrument_conventions.xauusd_pip_size: 0.10 USD (DR-301) — EXPLICIT research convention, NOT a broker-fill claim

intrabar_policy: if stop and target are both touched inside one 1m bar with no LTF evidence -> AMBIGUOUS_INTRABAR_ORDER; NEVER choose the profitable ordering; record pessimistic_case/optimistic_case/ordering_unknown; withhold the definitive training label

causal_separation.labels_observed_after_decision: from bars with open > decision_ts only
causal_separation.hard_rule: labels never modify candidate generation / OTE anchors / setup-family / source-tier / lane decisions / the original hypothesis
